messages:
sara chen: Quick ask — can someone run the vpc_io_sampling benchmark on the onprem preprod node and compare against hosted numbers? Seeing ~2-3x tail latency in a few traces. Command & env below.

josh w: Which host exactly? I can grab it in a bit.

sara chen: host: onprem-preprod-03 (dc1 rack4). bench cmd: `./scripts/run_bench --suite vpc_io_sampling --concurrency 8 --seq 1024 --duration 300`

sara chen: also try with `NET_RX_COPYBREAK=262144` env var and with irq affinity pinned to cores 4-7.

anita r: I can run this now. Anything special about the kernel or nic? driver is ixgbe.

sara chen: kernel: 5.15.92, firmware: ixgbe 5.8. config we usually test: IRQ=no, rps rx flow set to 4096, tso off. if you can collect `perf record -a -g` and a flamegraph that would help.

anita r: running first pass (baseline). queuing perf + flamegraph.

infra-bot: bench-runner: job queued -> job id 59673 for onprem-preprod-03 (vpc_io_sampling, concurrency=8). ETA ~5m.

anita r: baseline results (attached): p50 12ms, p95 73ms, p99 210ms. Hosted baseline was p99 ~90ms. Full perf stack in /tmp/59673/.

max p: Those numbers feel like NIC offload/TX path issues. Can you check `ethtool -k eth0` and `cat /proc/interrupts | grep eth0`? Also try `echo 0 > /proc/irq/XX/smp_affinity` for non-nic irqs.

anita r: ethtool -k shows tso=on, gro=on, gso=on. I flipped tso/gro/gso off and re-ran: p50 11ms, p95 48ms, p99 120ms. So big win but still ~1.3x worse than hosted.

sara chen: good catch. can we confirm CPU affinity + frequency governor? onprem nodes historically run ondemand vs hosted running performance.

anita r: governor is powersave. switched to performance for test -> p99 95ms. matches hosted within noise.

josh w: thanks all. So summary: default onprem config (tso/gro/gso on + powersave) explains the regression. We should bake a small init script for preprod/onprem to set NIC offloads and governor for perf lanes.

sara chen: @josh w can you review my PR that adds the netdev/sysctl toggles? PR #4321. It's small.

josh w: will review this afternoon. quick reminder to include an opt-in flag for non-prod only.

anita r: uploaded flamegraphs and perf traces to the ticket. links: https://internal.redwood/trace/59673, https://internal.redwood/flame/59673

max p: we should also add a smoke test in the onprem bootstrapping playbook to assert governor=performance for dedicated inference nodes. I'll open a follow-up.

sara chen: sounds good. thanks team :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-status: configuration change PR #4321 created against infra/playbooks; CI checks queued.

josh w: reviewed and left small nits. will approve after tests pass.

anita r: happy to re-run the bench after PR lands to validate automation.

sara chen: async follow-ups ok. We'll close this thread once we see a green run and a short note in the infra changelog.
